539-3821-3899-4679-6821.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two lands excluding Yenna that can tap for mana.
539-3821-3899-4679-6821.description:
Cause Peregrine Drake to become an enchantment using Jump Scare.
Activate up to four lands excluding Yenna by tapping them, adding at least {2}
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Peregrine Drake
When the Peregrine Drake token enters, it triggers, untapping Yenna and up to four other lands.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the Peregrine Drake token, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit.
Repeat from step 2.

529-3197-7297-8181.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, causing you to surveil 1.
Denzilore triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

requires.n: One-drop creature with a second body

1957-4050-6559--204.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the one-drop creature, adding {B}.
When that creature dies, it and Venerated Stormsinger trigger.
Resolve the creature's ability, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Venerated Stormsinger ability, gaining at least one life and causing at least one opponent to lose at least one life.
When you gain life, Veinwitch Coven triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return the one-drop creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the token creature, adding one colored mana.
Cast the creature by paying one mana.
Repeat.

6733-7841-8089.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is a multiple of 3.
6733-7841-8089.description:
Activate Arco-Flagellant by paying life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

1170-5131-6595-6798--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-5131-6595-6798--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Lyse Hext.
Displacer Kitten and Lyse Hext's prowess ability trigger.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the Lyse Hext trigger, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the artifact, causing you to surveil 1
Repeat.

1349-5147-6854.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional nontoken creature with a coin counter on it.
1349-5147-6854.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature with a coin counter on it.
When the creature dies, Athreos's second ability and Host of the Hereafter's ability trigger.
Resolve the Host of the Hereafter trigger, putting a coin counter onto itself as well as +1/+1 counters if those were present.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Host of the Hereafter.
When Host of the Hereafter dies, it and Athreos's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Host of the Hereafter trigger, putting a coin counter and +1/+1 counters onto the other nontoken creature.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning Host of the Hereafter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 6.
Repeat.

5900-7839-7911.description:
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Gandalf.
When Gandalf enters, it triggers, dealing 3 damage to Smaug.
Smaug triggers, creating three Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.

4365-5658-6245-7824.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You have the city's blessing or control at least six permanents.
4365-5658-6245-7824.description:
Declare Satya as an attacker. Satya triggers, creating four token copies of Ocelot Pride that are tapped and attacking and causing you to get {E}{E}.
If you don't have the city's blessing, the Ocelot Pride token gives you the city's blessing.
At the beginning of your end step, Satya triggers four times, and each Ocelot Pride you control triggers once.
Resolve the first Ocelot Pride trigger, causing you to create three 1/1 Cat creature tokens if you gained life this turn, and then causing you to create three token copies of each creature token that entered the battlefield under your control this turn, and then causing you to create a token copy of each noncreature token that entered the battlefield under your control this turn.
Repeat step 4 for each remaining trigger.
4365-5658-6245-7824.notes: You may repeat this loop during subsequent turns to get even more creature tokens and ETB triggers.

1594-3641-4399-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Helm of Awakening.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Distinguished Conjurer triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Distinguished Conjurer trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Distinguished Conjurer trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1594-3641-4399-4770.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a +1/+1 counter on it and has lifelink

1495-4613-7436.description:
Activate Pest Mascot by using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life due to its lifelink.
Pest Mascot triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

943-4235-4552-7069.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding three mana of any color due to the ability given to it by Tectonic Split.
Activate Deserted Temple's second ability by tapping it, targeting the land
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Deserted Temple's ability, targeting Deserted Temple.
Resolve both Deserted Temple abilities, untapping Deserted Temple and the other land
Repeat
943-4235-4552-7069.notes: Once you have excess mana, you can untap other lands instead of [Land that Taps to Add Multiple Mana]].

1558-2638-3257-4231-4365.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-2638-3257-4231-4365.description:
Play Rakdos Carnarium.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters, it and Tireless Tracker trigger
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Mondrak.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

240-1879-4050-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing an Egg token, adding one mana of any color
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2292-4871-5220-5651.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
2292-4871-5220-5651.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

2440-3188-3399-4399.description:
Cast Stormfront Riders by paying {4}{W/P} due to Defiler of Faith.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Mana Echoes and Social Climber triggers.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Soldier you control.
Resolve the Social Climber trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Stormfront Riders spell. When it enters, it, Mana Echoes and Social Climber trigger.
Resolve the Social Climber trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Stormfront Riders trigger, returning it and the Soldier token created in step 2 from the battlefield to your hand.
Stormfront Riders' second ability triggers twice.
Resolve a Stormfront Riders trigger, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat steps 3 through 5 one additional time.
Repeat from step 10 for the remaining trigger.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger from step 6, adding {C} for each Soldier you control.
Repeat.

141-2034-2562.description:
Cast Graceful Reprieve by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Graceful Reprieve, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Graceful Reprieve.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, Graceful Reprieve triggers, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1385-1497-2173-5220.description:
Activate Wild Cantor by sacrificing it.
When Wild Cantor dies, Mortuary and Zulaport Cutthroat trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Wild Cantor from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Zulaport Cutthroat trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Wild Cantor from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

193-407-3604.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Swamps.
193-407-3604.description:
Cast Aminatou by paying {W}{U}{B}.
When Aminatou enters the battlefield, Cadric triggers.
Holding priority, activate Cabal Coffers by paying {2} and tapping it, adding at least {B}{B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Cadric trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Aminatou.
Activate Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Cabal Coffers.
Activate the token Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking the nontoken Aminatou.
Repeat from step 2.
193-407-3604.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can blink other permanent(s) instead. If those permanents are legendary, you can copy them via Cadric.

3436-3918-4038.description:
Activate Trazyn using Worn Powerstone's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Trazyn using Farmstead Gleaner's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Trazyn.
Repeat.

4499-4605-5542-6463.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Meticulous Artisan.
When Meticulous Artisan enters the battlefield, it triggers once, and Preston triggers twice.
Resolve the Meticulous Artisan trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the first Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Meticulous Artisan that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Meticulous Artisan token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat from step 4 for the remaining Preston trigger.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.
Repeat.

465-803-969-3742-4251.notablePrerequisites: Arcane Adaptation on the battlefield with "Samurai" chosen.
465-803-969-3742-4251.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

773-1912-4499.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {1}, blinking Galazeth Prismari.
When Galazeth Prismari enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

803-862-5852.notablePrerequisites: Arcane Adaptation on the battlefield with "Sliver" chosen
803-862-5852.description:
Cast Crimson Kobolds by paying {0}, and choosing to pay its replicate cost an arbitrarily large number of times by paying {0}.
Crimson Kobolds triggers, creating a copy of it for each time its replicate cost was paid.
Resolve all Crimson Kobolds spells, causing the nontoken Crimson Kobolds to enter the battlefield, and creating a token copy of it for each time its replicate cost was paid.

3017-4798-5631-5686.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
3017-4798-5631-5686.description:
Activate Ghostly Pilferer by discarding Ovalchase Daredevil.
Activate Shilgengar's first ability by sacrificing another creature, creating a Blood token.
When the Blood enters the battlefield, Ovalchase Daredevil triggers, returning Ovalchase Daredevil from your graveyard to your hand.
Skeleton Crew triggers, creating a 2/2 Skeleton Pirate creature token.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-2267-4798-5686.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
392-2267-4798-5686.description:
Activate Harnfel by discarding Ovalchase Daredevil, causing you to exile the top two cards of your library with the ability to play them this turn.
Activate Shilgengar's first ability by sacrificing another creature, creating a Blood token.
When the Blood enters the battlefield, Ovalchase Daredevil triggers, returning Ovalchase Daredevil from your graveyard to your hand.
Tormod triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat.

413-3356.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
413-3356.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing another creature, dealing 1 damage to Polyraptor.
Polyraptor triggers, creating a token copy of itself.
When the Polyraptor token enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat, sacrificing the damaged Polyraptor instead.

915-4306-5295.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four devotion to any color.
915-4306-5295.description:
Activate Nyx Lotus by tapping it, adding at least {4}.
Activate Synod Artificer's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Thousand-Year Elixir and Nyx Lotus.
Activate Thousand-Year Elixir by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Synod Artificer.
Repeat.

427-1283-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Kydele.
You have drawn at least two cards this turn.
Kydele does not have summoning sickness.
427-1283-3525.description:
Activate Kydele by tapping it, adding at least {2}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {1}, untapping Kydele.
Repeat.

1446-2034-2060-4549-4680.notablePrerequisites: Crystalline Crawler has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
1446-2034-2060-4549-4680.description:
Activate Viral Drake by paying {3}{U}, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Venser triggers, creating a legendary 3/3 The Hollow Sentinel artifact creature token.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping The Hollow Sentinel, adding {1}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing The Hollow Sentinel, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

678-4050-4242.notablePrerequisites: You have seven or more cards in your graveyard.
678-4050-4242.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Su-Chi, adding one mana of any color.
Su-Chi dies, triggering itself and Enduring Renewal.
Resolve the Su-Chi trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, causing you to return Su-Chi from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Su-Chi by paying {4}.
Repeat.

751-1812-2440.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Drake creatures.
751-1812-2440.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers itself and Mana Echoes.
Resolve the Mana Echoes ability, adding at least {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve Shrieking Drake's ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Prismite by paying {2}, adding {U}.
Repeat any number of times.
Once you have infinite colorless mana, you may activate Prismite any number of times.

662-1486-1651.description:
Cause Magda to become an artifact using Liquimetal Coating.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Magda and another artifact, targeting Magda.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Clock of Omens ability, untapping Magda.
Repeat from step 2.
